messages.content: Suppose a sequence of polynomials B_n(x) converge pointwise to f(x) on [0, 1]. Does it follow that the B_n converge uniformly? Ensure that stop words constitute no more than 20% of the total words in your response.

message.content: No. Pointwise convergence does not imply uniform convergence. Consider $B_n(x) = x^n$ on [0,1]. Limit is zero for $x<1$, one at $x=1$. Discontinuous limit contradicts uniform convergence property requiring continuous limits from continuous functions. Thus, answer remains negative.
